scope: Read-only logbook document context; local fictional validation only
status: implemented and tested locally; not published by this agent
implementation: Book and reference UUIDs are authoritative; never match by filename, cells, inventory text or entry author.
Current named member, logs.view and book-specific logs.references checked in one read transaction.
Unreleased references excluded before pagination and counts for non-administrators.
Page-only source/media reads; unique downloadable image per SHA with MIME, size and SHA256 checked against stored bytes.
Explicit unavailable_file_count for media omitted from a transfer. No invented original XLSX download or folder link.
Existing reference viewer and existing image endpoints recheck access/release/ref membership and SHA at download.
No database schema, writes, migrations, deletion or permission grants. No author-profile inference and no expansion of entry.related_record_id.

cases: Real passive XLSX import -> restricted source -> release -> review cells -> exact PNG download -> archive retains source; read queries leave full DB dump unchanged.
Exact book association; duplicate titles sort stably; restricted sources absent from totals/names/file metadata before pagination.
Release revoked after list; capability revoked; logs.view prerequisite; account disabled; final image denied.
Foreign reference/book image substitution denied; duplicate images deduplicated; omitted media explicit; corrupt bytes rejected; hidden corruption does not reveal metadata.
Vessel-only alias works only for explicitly scoped book; ordinary context stays denied; unrelated book hidden; removed site grant denies final download.
Vessel-specific reference right required; withdrawn book and inactive site deny context and final image.
Entry authorship does not attach shared book references to the person profile.
Malformed stored JSON, bad SHA/path-shaped ID and unsafe MIME fail closed without file links.

environment_note: Two sandbox attempts were stopped after no first-test progress. The same isolated fixtures passed via require_escalated local runner; no product change was needed. No TestClient processes remain owned by this agent.
limitations: No browser interaction, screen rendering, production data, live application, deployment or external messages were used.
Original workbook source bytes are not retained by the existing importer; cards provide extracted content and stored raster images.
